_about: Extra wordings for scripts/mail_sync.py beyond its built-in English and German ones. One list of regular expressions per mail kind. Text is matched case-insensitively against the subject plus the start of the body, accents kept as written. Add the wordings of your own language here (or in profile/mail_patterns.json, which is merged on top). Keep expressions specific: a rejection pattern that also appears in an acknowledgement turns acknowledgements into rejections.
